title: Acceptance Probability Under Domain Reindexing
statement: Let $\Omega,\Omega',\beta$ be types, let $r$ be a natural number, let $e\colon\Omega\to\Omega'$ be any map, let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester on domain $\Omega$ with output type $\beta$ and $r$ query positions, and let $f\colon\Omega'\to\beta$. The acceptance probability of the tester obtained by mapping each query through $e$, on input function $f$, equals the acceptance probability of $T$ on the composite function $f\circ e$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester with domain $\Omega$, codomain $\beta$, and $r$ query positions
